CreateRentalContract.pageSubtitle: Choose a property, look up the tenant, set the lease terms, then send for signing.

hero.title: Create a rental contract that stays fully inside your signing system
hero.subtitle: Set up the property, tenant, and commercial terms once, then send a clean DocuSign envelope without relying on off-platform state changes.

stats.deliveryValue: DocuSign envelope generated and tracked in-platform

descriptions.1: Select one of your properties to pull details into the contract.
descriptions.2: Enter the tenant's email to look up their profile — name and phone are filled automatically.
descriptions.3: Set the rent, deposit, and lease timeline that belong in the generated agreement.
descriptions.4: Review the final summary before creating a draft or sending the envelope for signature.
